_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-11-02 10:36, after proving out the Ashta defense (MB98a) and reading the fauna list: "let's start with these on there planets: A Mossgnath thats trampling crops, put it down. Red Mile Mauler pack. Siren pack. Kreet Stalker defense"
_note: THE RED MILE MAULERS: a pack of three, as the lore has them ("often encountered in groups of three"). Three defeats as a group, any order, so no line says first or last. NARROW, as MB98a: pinned to the creature's own planet, so the words name the creature and the planet aloud (his exemption, 2026-10-26).

STAND-INS, two: (1) the target. Searched 11-02 (gen_inspect Npc 'Mauler', 'RedMile', 'Porrima'): only tankgirlsxenologyexpanded.esm's TG_OutpostClone_RedMileMauler, a third-party mod we must not depend on. The vanilla Mauler's EditorID does not carry its name; Eliza's or his. (2) place.planet 'Porrima III' is not in the closed table yet.
A DRAFT ID: MB ids stop at two digits (MB99a was the last free one, 11-02), so this waits for gen_delve name, as missionboard33a became MB98a. The numbering cap is Eliza's to raise.
SEQUENTIAL, 11-02: the lint refuses a defeat in an any-order group, so the three are hunted in a fixed order (edge, far edge, centre) and the lines count up.

place._theme: A quiet site on Porrima III, home of the Red Mile.

prose.name: Hunt: Red Mile Maulers on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Three Red Mile Maulers have settled in around the <Place>, and Maulers don't move on once they've settled. The site wants all three put down.
prose.card: Settlement Contract. Hunt the three Red Mile Maulers at the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion.

broadcast: They always come in threes, and they never stray far from each other. Find one and the other two won't be long behind. Take them one at a time if they let you.

say: One down. The other two will have heard that.

beats.journal: I put down the second Red Mile Mauler at the <Place>. Now I need to find the last one.
say: Two down. The last one won't run, they never do.

say: That's all three. We can stop sleeping in shifts.
